summary: Full-system test for iteration 38: NEW Bot Connections (backend + UI), NEW ops-alerts per-event toggles, plus regression (auth, super-admin gating, messaging, projects, admin storage/DB tab). 18/18 backend pytest cases pass. All 3 new bot flows (create/show token/copy cURL/toggle/rotate/delete) verified via Playwright. All 9 admin data-testids on Storage & DB tab render including ops-event-update/payment/destructive, ops-webhook-minlevel, ops-webhook-quiet. Ops-webhook save+event-toggle round-trips persist; test with no URL returns helpful 400. Bots are per-user (demo cannot see admin's bots). Rotate correctly invalidates old token (401). Disabled bot ingest returns 403. Invalid/missing tokens return 401. Bot messages appear in the target channel with '🤖 <bot name>' display.

issues: React hydration warning in dev: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' on the bot-channel-select and bot-ws-select <option> children. Caused by the emergent dev-tooling instrumenting the `#{c.name}` text expression with a wrapping <span>. Non-blocking in production; consider whitelisting <option> children in the instrumentation.

verified: POST /api/auth/login for admin@stitches.app and demo@stitches.app return 200 with token
POST /api/admin/ops-webhook with events={update:false,payment:true,destructive:false} + min_level=warn + quiet_enabled=true persists; GET returns the same values
POST /api/admin/ops-webhook/test with no saved url returns 400 with helpful detail
POST /api/bots creates bot with stbot_ token, enabled=true, message_count=0
GET /api/bots lists the created bot for its owner only (demo cannot see admin's bot)
POST /api/bots/ingest 401 with missing/invalid Bearer token; 200 with valid token, message_id returned
After ingest, bot.message_count increments in GET /api/bots and message text appears in GET /api/channels/{id}/messages
POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate returns new stbot_ token; old token now 401; new token 200
DELETE /api/bots/{id} removes bot; subsequent ingest with the (now orphaned) token returns 401

UI /bots: new-bot-btn, create-bot-modal, bot-name-input, bot-ws-select, bot-channel-select, create-bot-submit, bot-card, bot-token (masked then Show), bot-copy-token, bot-copy-curl, bot-toggle, bot-rotate, bot-delete all render and function

UI /admin Storage & DB tab: ops-webhook-section, db-section, storage-section, audit-section, ops-event-update, ops-event-payment, ops-event-destructive, ops-webhook-minlevel, ops-webhook-quiet all render; ops-webhook-save clickable
Regression: POST /api/messages posts a message (200); GET /api/projects returns list; /projects UI page loads with kanban card visible
Nav 'Bots' link visible in left sidebar for logged-in user
critical_code_review_comments: bots.py _auth_bot: token accepted from either Authorization header OR body 'token'. Body-token fallback expands the attack surface (bot tokens in server access logs / referer). Consider header-only auth or requiring content-type/JSON only.
bots.py: message text is silently truncated at 4000 chars ([:4000]) with no client hint. Consider returning a warning field or rejecting with 413 when payload > 4000.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_qa_bot and TEST_ui_bot_iter38 bots + a few TEST_ messages during runs. Cleanup fixture removes all TEST_ bots; UI test explicitly deletes its bot. Ops-webhook state restored to defaults (events all true, min_level=info, quiet_enabled=false, url empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 38 features fully working.
